question: The length of the common chord of two intersecting circles is 24 cm. If the diameter of the circles are 30 cm and 26 cm, then the distance between the centres (in cm) is:
solution:
**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e9758ffa3081acdb07e469cc295ae05775a0584cfd5d597b612842f39185a94.png] 

Shown above are the two intersecting circles with AB the common chord.

X and Y are the centers of the circles.

The line XY joins the two circles and are perpendicular to chord AB. Hence, they bisect the chord AB at point O.

⇒ AO = AB/2 = 24/2 = 12 cm

AX and AY are the radius of the respective circles.

⇒ Hence, AX = 26/2 = 13 cm and AY = 30/2 = 15 cm

ΔAOX and ΔAOY are right-angled triangles

Hence, AX2 = AO2 + OX2 and AY2 = AO2 + OY2

⇒ OX2 = 132 – 122 and OY2 = 152 - 122

⇒ OX2 = 25 and OY2 = 81

Hence, OX = 5 and OY = 9

⇒ XY = OX + OY

⇒ XY = 9 + 5

⇒ XY = 14

**∴ Option 2 is the correct answer.**
